foundation_name: Evidence-Bound Vertical AI Multi-AI Operation Foundation V1
responsibility: Design evidence-bound Multi-AI Operation Vertical AI capacity that coordinates certified consumers via CIL, with Cursor as orchestrator host, without mutating Platform Core or CIL.

components.name: Multi-AI Context
components.responsibility: Assemble a read-only multi-AI operation context from ROE, CIL, V2 planning, and certified connector snapshots.

components.name: Consumer Selection
components.responsibility: Select which certified consumer (Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini/Cursor/MCP) is engaged for a coordination task, via CIL only, using evidence-bound criteria.

components.name: Task Orchestration
components.responsibility: Design the sequencing of multi-AI coordination tasks with Cursor as orchestrator host; execution stays delegated to Agent Runtime and repository operations to ROE.

components.name: Handoff Strategy
components.responsibility: Declare descriptor-only handoffs between consumers with fingerprints; no enactment; human approval required before any repository mutation.

components.name: Coordination Contract
components.responsibility: Declare the multi-AI coordination boundary contract: consumes Platform Core V1, CIL V1, certified connectors, and ROE only; forbids Platform Core/CIL mutation and unapproved repository mutation.

components.name: Coordination Evidence
components.responsibility: Bind fingerprints and refs so every multi-AI coordination conclusion is preceded by ROE, CIL, and V2 planning evidence.

components.name: Coordination Traceability
components.responsibility: Maintain evidence-to-coordination traceability from ROE and CIL evidence through consumer selection, orchestration, handoff, and approval readiness.

components.name: Coordination Reproducibility
components.responsibility: Ensure identical evidence and ROE inputs yield identical multi-AI coordination design fingerprints across dual runs.

components.name: Role Assignment
components.responsibility: Assign consumer roles aligned with CIL: Cursor as primary IDE operator/orchestrator host, Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini as reasoning peers, MCP as tool protocol peer.

components.name: Approval Gate
components.responsibility: Require explicit human approval before any repository mutation that multi-AI coordination might later recommend; foundation runs remain read-only.

components.name: Coordination Boundary
components.responsibility: Codify and design integrity checks for certified coordination boundaries across Platform Core, CIL, ROE, certified connectors, and the repository mutation gate.

components.name: Multi-AI Runtime Reference
components.responsibility: Reference the certified surfaces a future Multi-AI Operation Runtime will bind (ROE, Agent Runtime, CIL runtime connector); reference-only, no mutation.
